title: Split component modules contain unresolved type annotations
reasoning: These modules reference names such as `Callable`, `Path`, and `RepairAction` in annotations without defining or importing them at module scope. Postponed annotations prevent import-time failure, but Ruff's F821 analysis and `typing.get_type_hints` still encounter unresolved names, breaking the declared lint gate and runtime annotation introspection.
reproduction: Run `ruff check .`, or call `typing.get_type_hints` on an affected implementation function.
recommendation: Import every annotation dependency from `collections.abc`, `pathlib`, or the defining project module, as appropriate.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The tests import the modules with postponed annotations but do not resolve their type hints; pytest also does not automatically run the separate Ruff gate.
suggestedRegressionTest: Keep `ruff check .` as a required gate and add a small test resolving type hints for the split implementation modules.
minimumFixScope: Add missing type-only/runtime imports to checkpoint.py, git_ops.py, proof.py, and queue.py.
